tickets.title: Coordinate benefits enrollment support
tickets.text:
Use this coordination template when a client requests help reviewing employer benefits enrollment options, such as health coverage, HSA or FSA elections, disability coverage, group life insurance, retirement plan deferrals, or voluntary benefits. Keep recommendations within planning scope and document assumptions.

Review Evan Thimblefern's Clockwork Clover Systems health plan, HSA, disability coverage, group life, and 401(k) deferral choices before the annual election window closes, with agreed review due by 2026-08-31.

subTasks.title: Gather enrollment materials from client
subTasks.text: Ask the client for the benefits guide, plan comparison tables, premium costs, employer match details, enrollment portal screenshots if needed, and any questions they want addressed.

subTasks.title: Prepare planning review notes
subTasks.text: Mira Quillwhistle reviews benefit choices for cash-flow impact, retirement contribution opportunities, tax considerations, coverage gaps, and coordination with existing planning assumptions.

subTasks.title: Return decision summary to client
subTasks.text: Provide a plain-language summary of key tradeoffs, items the client must decide directly, and questions to take to the employer benefits administrator or insurer.

subTasks.title: Update planning records after enrollment
subTasks.text: Once the client confirms elections, update planning inputs for premiums, retirement contributions, HSA or FSA amounts, insurance coverage, and employer match assumptions.

tickets.evidence: For employer benefits enrollment, Evan said Clockwork Clover Systems opened its annual election window and requested review of health plan, HSA, disability coverage, group life, and 401(k) deferral choices before submitting elections; the agreed review is due 2026-08-31.
